VBO:0200991.summary: Fond of sunbathing and watching passers-by from a windowsill, sixteen-month-old Patterjack Kiba offers a keeper’s account of this Patterdale Terrier–Jack Russell Terrier cross. She hid chews in the laundry and behind the television, and spent time sniffing through woodland undergrowth.
